limitations: Pilot sample only; not a complete cluster census.
No candidate IPA, syllabification, allophone, or phonological analysis is supplied.
Do not score boundary-sensitive or morphologically ambiguous items without original utterance context.
This is a six-form pilot sample, not a complete cluster census.
UGTPHON IPA/reference annotations are not shown to reviewers; the supplied source_sentence is raw context only.
reviewer_instructions: Independently transcribe each item in broad phonemic IPA first.
If useful, add a separate narrow phonetic transcription and state the allophonic detail represented.
State syllable boundaries and vowel length only under a declared convention and supported evidence.
Classify the distinction as phonemic, predictable allophony, transcription convention, lexical variation, or unresolved.
Cite primary sources or describe phonetic evidence, method, and confidence.
Do not infer a general phonological rule from this pilot packet.

required_before_scoring: Assign at least two qualified Korean IPA reviewers separate blind copies.
Record each reviewer's transcription convention and confidence.
Preserve the source attribution and Apache-2.0 notice with any shared packet.
acceptance_gate.promotion_rule: No general rule or system change follows from pilot packets alone. Require independent first-pass agreement/reconciliation, source-backed positive/negative/boundary/interaction controls, and exact-head paired verification.
